description: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is a local command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagrams; not a hosted API.
auth_notes: Local npm/Docker CLI with no credentials documented in the sources. Separate hosted Mermaid API (different product) uses Bearer API key.
gate_detail: The sources do not describe credentials for the CLI; it is installed and run locally. The separate hosted Mermaid API reportedly works with free accounts and a monthly credit allowance.
api_scope: Command-line tool plus a Node.JS API that is not covered by semver; no hosted endpoints for the CLI.
mcp_notes: Official Mermaid MCP Server exists for the Mermaid.ai product, not the CLI repo; no MCP in the CLI sources.
blocker_detail: mermaid-cli is a local command-line renderer, not a hosted first-party API requiring developer credentials.

evidence.quote: Command line tool for the Mermaid library
It's possible to call mermaid-cli via a Node.JS API.
Mermaid API is a hosted service that runs Mermaid for you
Any Mermaid account works, including a free one

uncertainties: Auth and access quotes come from the separate hosted Mermaid API (S6), not the CLI; no source states the CLI needs no credentials.
S3 (MERMAID coral reef API) and S4 (another mermaid CLI) are unrelated products.
